data.one_liner: A Page Route Transition library that helps implement page transition animations.
data.what_it_does: Provides pre-built page transition animations like right-to-left, fade, scale, and bottom-to-top for Flutter navigation. Allows pushing routes with custom visual effects and durations.
use_when: You want to add smooth animations when navigating between pages.
You prefer an imperative approach to page transitions using custom route builders.
avoid_when: You are using a declarative routing solution like GoRouter that handles its own page transitions.
You require complex, interactive, physics-driven shared element transitions.
strengths: Simple API with multiple built-in transition effects (fade, scale, slide, etc.).
Easy setup with minimal boilerplate required.
weaknesses: Imperative usage may not integrate seamlessly with advanced declarative routers.

alternatives.name: page_transition
alternatives.why_pick_it: It provides a similar set of ready-to-use page transition animations for Flutter navigation.
